task_completion.description: Open the Webots simulation environment with the AS/RS pallet crane model.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Webots application window is visible, showing a 3D scene with a pallet crane or warehouse structure.

task_completion.description: Set X_AXIS_JOINT parameters: minStop 0.0, maxStop 25.0, and maxVelocity 3.0.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Webots scene tree or a node editor shows X_AXIS_JOINT selected with JointParameters (minStop: 0, maxStop: 25) and LinearMotor (maxVelocity: 3) fields updated.

task_completion.description: Set Y_AXIS_JOINT parameters: minStop 0.2, maxStop 8.5, and maxVelocity 1.5.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Webots scene tree or a node editor shows Y_AXIS_JOINT selected with JointParameters (minStop: 0.2, maxStop: 8.5) and LinearMotor (maxVelocity: 1.5) fields updated.

task_completion.description: Set Z_AXIS_JOINT parameters: minStop -1.2, maxStop 1.2, and maxVelocity 0.5.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Webots scene tree or a node editor shows Z_AXIS_JOINT selected with JointParameters (minStop: -1.2, maxStop: 1.2) and LinearMotor (maxVelocity: 0.5) fields updated.

task_completion.description: Save the modified world to the specific path /home/ga/Desktop/asrs_configured.wbt.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Save As' dialog box or a terminal command shows the file being saved to /home/ga/Desktop/asrs_configured.wbt, or the window title reflects the new filename.

integrity.description: The agent used the Webots GUI to modify parameters rather than just writing a text file via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Webots Scene Tree or field editor.

integrity.description: The agent entered the exact numerical values specified in the task, not default or random values.
integrity.visual_evidence: The specific numbers (e.g., 25.0, 8.5, -1.2) are visible in the Webots property fields.

integrity.description: The agent performed a real save action to the desktop path.
integrity.visual_evidence: The File menu or a file explorer window confirms the creation of 'asrs_configured.wbt' on the Desktop.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must configure three specific joints in Webots: X_AXIS_JOINT (minStop: 0.0, maxStop: 25.0, maxVelocity: 3.0), Y_AXIS_JOINT (minStop: 0.2, maxStop: 8.5, maxVelocity: 1.5), and Z_AXIS_JOINT (minStop: -1.2, maxStop: 1.2, maxVelocity: 0.5).
